dedupe_keys.name: sentinel 2 multi label dataset for waterway port and railway detection in germany

description: This dataset provides 10,000 Sentinel-2 image chips of 224 by 224 pixels, each covering 512 m, labelled for the presence of waterways, ports and railways in Germany. The labels are derived from OpenStreetMap features, so each chip can carry several labels at once, which makes it a multi-label benchmark for transport infrastructure detection from satellite imagery. It was published on Zenodo on 2026-07-13 by researchers at Helmut-Schmidt- University. Coverage is Germany. Access: a free 117 MB zip download under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: labels inherit the completeness and positional error of OpenStreetMap, and the 10 m Sentinel-2 resolution limits small features such as single tracks or small quays. It supports machine-learning mapping of transport assets for exposure inventories where asset registers are missing, and change detection for infrastructure monitoring; it complements the OpenStreetMap-based network data catalogued here.
